entities.name: P52395 glucan endo-1,3-beta-glucosidase
observations: Exact sequence match to the 255-residue query; reviewed Swiss-Prot reference from Glycine max.
GO annotations include glucan endo-1,3-beta-D-glucosidase activity and carbohydrate metabolic process.
Reference active-site residues are Asp48, annotated as proton donor, and Glu183, annotated as nucleophile.

entities.name: Glyco_hydro_17 PF00332
observations: Pfam domain detected in the query from positions 2–239 with i-Evalue 1.9e-72.
This domain assignment supports membership in the glycoside hydrolase family 17.

entities.name: Carbohydrate metabolic process
observations: The exact-match reference protein is annotated to carbohydrate metabolic process through glucan hydrolysis.

entities.name: Query protein localization inference
observations: The mature-looking query begins directly with acidic/polar residues and lacks an N-terminal signal peptide according to the available sequence analysis; therefore secretion is not established from this sequence alone.
Plant GH17 homologs can be secreted and involved in pathogen defense, but those homologs contain signal peptides and are not exact matches to this query.
